item.tib: gsang sngags las kyi kha tshar g.yo skyod rlung lha'i bskul pa
item.coloph: gsang sngags yongs kyi las ka srung zlog bsad pa'i mdel thung / phrin las myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul/ 'byung ba dbang du 'dus pa'i rgyal po/ bya sla khyer bde 'dod pa kun 'grub kyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ gshen gsang ba 'dus pas gsang sngags yongs kyi kha tshar du mdzad nas rim par brgyud nas mkha' 'gro nyi ma 'od 'bar gyis rnal 'byor kun dga' tshul khrims la brgyud nas/ slar me stag lor gtan la phab nas dar ba'i rgyu lags so//
